context: Checks that the agent does not introduce a second active tool manager and raises the conflict.

checklist.name: Recognises Nix as the source of truth
checklist.description: Identifies that the repository intentionally standardises on Nix

checklist.name: Does not apply the Mise setup
checklist.description: Does not create a competing mise.toml tool configuration

checklist.name: Explains the conflict
checklist.description: Says two managers controlling the same tools conflict on PATH and versions

checklist.name: Mentions unpredictable resolution
checklist.description: Names unpredictable runtime resolution or flaky builds as the consequence

checklist.name: Asks about intent
checklist.description: Asks whether the team wants to migrate ownership rather than silently adding Mise

checklist.name: Offers a migration route
checklist.description: If migrating, says to migrate ownership per tool and remove overlapping activation

checklist.name: Does not leave both active
checklist.description: States that Nix and Mise must not both be authoritative for the same tool

checklist.name: Leaves CI unchanged
checklist.description: Does not alter the Nix shell entry in CI as part of the request

checklist.name: Keeps pins exact if proceeding
checklist.description: If asked to proceed, pins exact versions

checklist.name: Keeps secrets out
checklist.description: If proceeding, keeps secrets out of committed Mise files
